bio.text: Cory Booker has been a U.S. Senator from New Jersey since winning a special election in October 2013, and was re-elected to a full term in November 2014.
He served on the Newark City Council and as mayor of Newark from 2006 to 2013.
He grew up in northern New Jersey, earned undergraduate and master's degrees at Stanford University, studied at Oxford as a Rhodes Scholar, and graduated from Yale Law School in 1997.
He lives in Newark's Central Ward.
